name: Agent status
description: Turns agent hooks into live status rows and durable per-session Activity threads.

method.description: Sessions that have an agent status row, with the row's summary.

display.description: What the window draws: working, monitoring, waiting, permission, blocked, failed, interrupted, done, unverifiable, idle or unconfirmed.

detail.description: One readable line; never a JSON object.

progress.description: 0 to 100 as a percentage, or null when the program reports none.

agent.description: The hook source that owns the row, e.g. claude or qwen-code.

method.description: A session's agent status row with its display state at a time, or null when it has none.

at.description: The time to compute the display at, in ms since the epoch; defaults to now.

result.description: The whole row plus `display` and `label`, or null.

method.description: Why a session has its script state: the status row and the evidence behind it, the screen rule that matched, and which of them decided.

at.description: Judge the row's freshness at this time, in ms since the epoch; defaults to now.

kind.description: Present when the state is blocked.

row.description: The session's status row as it reads now; null when it has none.

fresh.description: Evidence under 30 minutes old and not restored unconfirmed.

because.description: The evidence that last changed the row; null for a row stored before explain existed.

origin.description: Where a rule set comes from; null when absent.

path.description: The file, for a user or built-in set.

verdict.description: The rule that decided, or null.

origin.description: Where a rule set comes from.

path.description: The file, for a user or built-in set.

pendingQuiet.description: A rule that matches except that the screen has not been quiet long enough.

ignored.description: Sources skipped because they are invalid, with the reason.

origin.description: Where a rule set comes from.

path.description: The file, for a user or built-in set.

unavailable.description: Why the rules could not be run.

summary.description: One sentence naming the state and why.

method.description: Types a prompt into a session's agent, but never into one waiting for approval or an answer. The text is pasted, then Enter is written after the agent's submit delay and only after a fresh check; the call waits for the agent to start. Fails with conflict and a data.reason: agent-blocked (the agent is waiting; nothing was submitted), prompt-stalled (typed and submitted but the agent did not start in time), not-an-agent, or session-exited.

text.description: The prompt. Line breaks stay inside the one prompt.

startTimeoutMs.description: How long to watch for the agent to start after the first Enter, in ms; defaults to 5000.

state.description: What the agent was doing when the send settled; idle means a whole turn started and ended inside the window.

sentAt.description: When the first Enter was written, in ms since the epoch.

startedAt.description: When the agent was seen to have taken the prompt, in ms since the epoch.

method.description: Waits until a session's script state is one of the wanted states, for up to timeoutMs (at most 60000). Returns status matched with the state at once if it already is, else pending with the last state. Fails with conflict and data.reason session-exited when the session has exited and exited is not wanted. Callers that wait longer repeat the call.

until.description: The script states that end the wait, at least one; defaults to idle and blocked.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait in this call, in ms; defaults to 60000.

status.description: pending means timeoutMs passed without a wanted state.

state.description: The script state at the last look.

kind.description: Present when the state is blocked.

decidedBy.description: What decided the state: the session itself, a screen rule, the status row, or nothing.

rule.description: The screen rule that decided, when one did.

at.description: When the state was read, in ms since the epoch.

method.description: Waits until a line of a session's recent text matches a regular expression, for up to timeoutMs (at most 60000). Lines the terminal wrapped are read as one line. Returns status matched with the newest matching line at once if one does, else pending. An exited session's final text is matched before the exit counts. Fails with invalid-params for a pattern that does not compile, is unsafe or runs too long, and with conflict and data.reason session-exited when the session exited without a match.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression, without flags.

lines.description: How many lines of scrollback above the screen to read; defaults to 200.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait in this call, in ms; defaults to 60000.

status.description: pending means timeoutMs passed without a match.

line.description: The matching line; present when matched.

match.description: The text the pattern matched; present when matched.

groups.description: The capture groups, empty text for one that did not take part; present when matched.

at.description: When the text was read, in ms since the epoch.

method.description: The effective detection rules of every agent that has any, where each comes from, and the sources skipped as invalid.

origin.description: Where a rule set comes from; null when absent.

path.description: The file, for a user or built-in set.

rules.description: How many rules the effective set holds.

ignored.description: Sources skipped because they are invalid, with the reason.

origin.description: Where a rule set comes from.

path.description: The file, for a user or built-in set.

method.description: The detection rules that apply to one agent and where they come from, or null when none does.

origin.description: Where a rule set comes from.

path.description: The file, for a user or built-in set.

set.description: The rule file: agent, optional description and the ordered rules.

method.description: Whether Quirky's hooks are installed for each agent that takes them from a config file.

files.description: The files the installer may touch.

method.description: Installs Quirky's hooks for detected, enabled agents, or for one named agent. Refused while the Agent status hooks setting is off.

agent.description: The agent ID; every agent when omitted.

method.description: Removes Quirky's hooks for every agent, or for one named agent.

agent.description: The agent ID; every agent when omitted.

changed.description: The files this run changed or deleted.

method.description: Retained terminal Activity snapshots, attention-ordered and optionally filtered by worktree, text or unread state.

worktree.description: Only threads in this exact worktree ID.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring of prompt, provider, session or workspace text.

unreadOnly.description: Only threads whose current turn has not been acknowledged.

turn.description: Stable token for this turn; use it when acknowledging.

live.description: Whether the exact terminal session remains available.

method.description: Projects the retained Activity threads into Needs you, Working and Done columns. The total includes hidden idle cards; acknowledged completions remain Done.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring of prompt, provider, session or workspace text.

project.description: A project selector accepted by quirky.worktree/list.

showIdle.description: Reveal idle Activity cards, hidden by default.

detail.description: Readable status detail, never raw permission JSON.

total.description: Matching Activity threads, including hidden idle cards.

hiddenIdle.description: Matching idle cards omitted because showIdle is false.

unavailable.description: Optional GitHub review lookup failures; those unknown threads are excluded from review-filter results.

method.description: Acknowledges a specific Activity turn, or all current turns; an old token cannot acknowledge a newer turn.

session.description: Session ID for a turn-scoped acknowledgment.

turn.description: The observed turn token; if omitted, acknowledges the session's current turn.

all.description: Acknowledge all current Activity threads. Cannot be combined with session or turn.

method.description: Hides terminal Activity entries (done, failed or interrupted) without deleting sessions, status rows or transcripts.

worktree.description: Only terminal entries from this exact worktree ID.

job.description: Ends the rows of agents whose process has exited without saying so.

setting.title: Agent status hooks
setting.description: Shows working, waiting, and done states in Quirky. Turn off to remove Quirky-managed hooks and stop reinstalling them.

event.description: A session's agent status row changed or was removed.

row.description: The row after the change, or null when the row was removed.

event.description: Activity acknowledgment or clear markers changed without changing agent status rows.

sessionIds.description: The session IDs whose Activity receipts or clear markers changed.

event.description: A session's agent settled into done, waiting or blocked: a real change of state, never a replay or a session boundary.

outcome.description: success, cancellation or failure for a finished turn; null when the row carries none.

prompt.description: The turn's prompt, or null when there is none.

toolName.description: The tool the row is on or waits on, or null.

toolInput.description: That tool's input as one readable line, or null.

lastAssistantMessage.description: The agent's last message, or null.

at.description: When the row settled, in ms since the epoch.
